newsitem.title: FRANCE: French non-farm payrolls dropped 0.1 pct in Q3.
newsitem.headline: French non-farm payrolls dropped 0.1 pct in Q3.

text.p: French non-farm market-sector payrolls dropped a seasonally-adjusted 0.1 percent in the third quarter to 13,345,000 from 13,354,000 at end June, after being stable in the previous three quarters, Labour Ministry data showed.
The Labour Ministry added this was the first cut in non-farm payrolls in three years, since it fell 0.3 percent in Q4 1993.

The total active population available for work was 25,590,232 million at the end of March 1996, according to the latest available figures from the national statistics office, INSEE. At the end of October, some 3.23 million of those were unemployed according to narrow International Labour Organisation (ILO) criteria.
